reports.title: Vericel Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year Financial Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Full-Year Financial Guidance
section: •Raised total revenue guidance to $344 to $346 million, compared to $330 to $340 million previously
•Raised MACI revenue guidance to $290 to $292 million, compared to $284 to $290 million previously
•Raised Burn Care revenue guidance to $54 million, compared to $46 to $50 million previously
•Raised adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to 28%, compared to 27% previously
